claims.summary: The ordinary interval is eligible at t=240, but the secret interval measured from t=0 has not reached 300 seconds. An earlier secret reread would require a shorter secret interval, not merely an eligible ordinary check.

The first listed call after 300 seconds is t=360. Because all calls are 120 seconds apart and finish within one second, that call is also beyond the ordinary 60-second gate. Independent secret refresh then does not require an App Configuration change. No SDK check-order claim is made.

A changed WatchKey sentinel is a documented trigger for watched ordinary-setting reload. The separately configured secret_refresh_interval supports rotated secret values even when the reference and sentinel do not change.
